File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update amount parsing in `src/ingest/parser.ts` to strip currency symbols and thousand separators so that amounts with currency signs, commas, or apostrophes are successfully validated and parsed.
args.title: Strip currency symbols and thousand separators in amount parser

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The current amount parsing implementation rejects amounts containing currency signs and formatting characters like commas or apostrophes. Updating the parser to strip these symbols will ensure properly formatted currency amounts are correctly accepted.
